subject: 2026-10-14-anthropic-pentagon-rehearing-petition
text:
Brief says: "In September, the court upheld that label in a 2-1 decision, and the Pentagon did not immediately respond to a request for comment."
Source says: "In September, the D.C. Circuit upheld the Pentagon's blacklisting. The 2-1 decision rejected Anthropic's argument..." The no-comment line belongs to this week's filing: "The Pentagon didn't immediately respond to a request for comment." (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/anthropic-wants-court-in-dc-to-rehear-appeal-of-pentagon-blacklist-.html)
Suggested fix: "In September, the court upheld that label in a 2-1 decision. The Pentagon did not immediately respond to CNBC's request for comment on the new filing." (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
